svg.title: VoiceCon: live voice conversion for phone calls
svg.desc: Android-first AI voice calling, live on voicecon.app. 86 ms median GPU inference per 180 ms block, about 0.5 s server-side delay, 0 ms audio dropped over a 5-minute run, 336 backend tests. Fails closed: a conversion error ends the call.
svg.text: Live voice conversion over a normal phone call.
Android app, billing API, realtime gateway, GPU worker.
Any conversion error ends the call. Raw audio is never forwarded.
